title: Run a local newsletter with an AI command center
summary: A newsletter owner built an AI command center that finds stories, writes issues, tracks advertisers and reports reader clicks for his 15,000-subscriber local newsletter.
agent_role: The system finds stories, drafts issues, tracks advertisers and shows clicks. The owner's review role is not described.
outcome: Author reports using it to run his 15,000-subscriber local newsletter.
what_they_did: The poster built an AI command center for his local newsletter. It finds stories, writes issues, tracks advertisers and shows what readers click.
how_it_went: He says it runs his 15,000-subscriber newsletter; the full build is in a linked article.
prompt: Help me run my local newsletter about [your town]. Each week, search local news sources and event listings for [topics] and list 10 story ideas with links. After I pick, draft the issue in my style using [past issue example]. Keep a spreadsheet of advertisers with dates, ad slots and payment status. Show me the draft and wait for my approval before sending anything.

curation.rationale: A real non-coding small-business use running a 15,000-subscriber newsletter, but the post is a teaser and the details sit in an article we can't see.
